extraInstructions: IMPORTANT: You MUST import and use BOTH audioManager AND speechManager. Import speechManager from '../../../lib/sim-engine/speech'. Use audioManager.play() for sound effects (valid: pickup, drop-correct, drop-wrong, tap, success, error, celebration, hint). Use speechManager.speak() for spoken teaching slide narration, challenge questions, correct/incorrect feedback, and hints. The game must teach: (1) Internet introduction — the internet is a huge network that connects computers all over the world. It lets us share information, communicate, learn, and play. To connect: need a device (computer, tablet, phone) + internet connection (wifi, broadband, mobile data) + web browser. (2) Web browser — a browser is software to open and view websites. Common browsers: Google Chrome, Mozilla Firefox, Microsoft Edge. Browser parts: address bar (type website URL like www.google.com), search bar (type keywords to search), tabs (open multiple websites), back/forward buttons (navigate between pages), refresh (reload page), home (go to starting page). URL = Uniform Resource Locator = website address. To visit a website: open browser → type URL in address bar → press Enter → website loads → click links to explore. Misconceptions: 'the internet is a single computer' (internet is a NETWORK of millions of connected computers), 'browser and search engine are the same' (browser opens websites, search engine like Google finds websites), 'you can type anything in the address bar' (address bar needs a URL like www.google.com, search bar is for keywords), 'all websites are safe' (some websites have bad content or viruses — always ask parents before visiting new sites), 'wifi and internet are the same' (wifi is the wireless connection method, internet is the global network — you need both). Default width=720, height=560. Use named export (export function InternetGame), NOT export default. Export interface InternetGameProps with width?, height?, onComplete?: (score: number) => void.
